reviewDescription: It's hard to review these well because they are SO BIG they won't fit my child. Her current go to shoe is a size 9 from a different brand (which are the tiniest bit big), so I thought that would be the best size to order. These shoes are at least one size too big, maybe even 1.5 sizes bigger than her other shoes even though they are both listed as size 9 (note the fabric space in both toe and heel when compared to the other shoe). I really like the soft lining inside and the soles (while lacking tread) seem very durable. If they were the right size, the kiddo could probably get them on by herself, so fairly easy to use. They aren't as stylish as other slip ons, but it's a pretty basic style so it will match most casual outfits. At the current price of $20, they are probably a bit expensive, but if the color fits your needs it might be a go - just remember to size down!

reviewTitle: Cute Slip‑Ons, but Sizing and Quality Miss the Mark
reviewDescription: These size 10 slip‑on sneakers are very cute and have a simple, classic look that works well for everyday wear. However, they run noticeably big, and the material feels a bit stiff for little kid feet, especially for preschoolers who need extra flexibility and comfort. Right out of the box, the glue around the white rubber outsole looks slightly dingy, which gives the shoes a lower‑quality appearance than I normally expect from Amazon Essentials. It does not affect function, but it does affect first impressions. On the positive side, the inner heel has a nice amount of padding to help reduce rubbing, and the insoles are flat but soft enough to offer some comfort for casual use. Overall, these are cute and wearable, but the combination of sizing issues, stiffness, and some quality concerns put them at an average 3 stars for me, making the nearly $20 price point not a great value for the money.
